title: Approve the editorial and visual direction for the agent runtime identity Instagram post
outcome_ref: Publish a Cereja Flamejante Instagram post that connects the Batalha de Agentes Itaú experience to agent identity, authority and observability without overstating the origin of the current architecture.

governance_profile.notes: Recurring public-authority/brand decision with reputational impact. The asset and caption can be revised before publication.

inputs: approved Batalha de Agentes / Bússola factual context
criteria: the Batalha de Agentes is a real source of the governance question rather than a retroactive pretext
the Bússola is framed as support for financial education rather than autonomous financial decision-maker
the visual metaphor communicates agent identity and bounded authority without robot/cyberpunk clichés
the piece remains recognizably Cereja Flamejante in composition and tone
synthetic portrait is not presented as a real person or documentary evidence
no publication occurs before independent creative review and final Kell gate

authority_required.notes: Specialists propose and refine; Kell owns the current editorial/art-direction decision while this recurring decision class is still being calibrated.

exception_conditions: factual conflict about the event or Bússola
caption or asset drifts from approved provenance
visual execution materially diverges from approved art direction
native publication metadata cannot be verified

decision.story_route: Use the Batalha de Agentes Itaú and Bússola as the real context in which identity, authority, rules and observability became concrete concerns.
decision.visual_route: Use a physical credential as the metaphor for a non-human principal that must have identity, authority scope and state before acting.
decision.headline: Se o agente pode agir, ele precisa existir no sistema.
decision.approved_closing: Afinal, você não dá a chave da sua casa pra qualquer pessoa, né?

creative_review.authority: Creative Director review supplied by Kell; Kell confirmed variant 2 = PNG at commit 564fdc8
creative_review.required_revision: Remove only identidade · autoridade · estado · observabilidade; no replacement or recomposition
creative_review.freeze: Final master frozen for publish-gate review; no further creative changes unless Kell reopens direction.

decision.publication_status: published; observing; edits require new Kell gate
decision.bounded_revision: Removed the separate identidade · autoridade · estado · observabilidade line because it was conceptually important but not legible at channel scale. No replacement text or new art direction.

publication.authorization: Kell explicitly replied pode publicar after final preview
publication.grid_preview: not available before publishing in native web creation flow
publication.caption: approved caption verbatim; Markdown bold syntax rendered as plain text; no wording changes
publication.alt: approved alt entered and observed on published profile tile

expected_outcome: The final post should make agent identity/authority concrete and memorable while remaining faithful to Kell's real experience and current Cereja Flamejante visual/editorial system.
observed_outcome: Instagram confirmed Seu post foi compartilhado.; permalink opened and caption, four native tags and AI label verified. Published 2026-10-08 at 12:39:47 America/Sao_Paulo. Audience performance not yet measured.
learn_back: Creative Director PASS after one bounded revision.
Conceptually important copy should not survive as unreadable microcopy; promote it or remove it from the visual.
Illustrative credential microcopy may remain secondary because it signals system identity rather than carrying the core argument.
After publication, record performance and whether the approved decision criteria remained sufficient without additional human correction.
Human-in-the-loop final send completed: Kell explicitly authorized only after preview. Global and LATAM Google Cloud tags both selected by Kell. No post-publication creative/content edits.
